stage0045_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$カヲル$$
「As always, that's a good song.」

stage0045_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$カヲル$$
「There's someone I want to hear
　your song... Is that all right?」

stage0045_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Altair lost its women, and with only
　ruin ahead of us, we began surveying Vega
　to hold onto a thread of hope.）

stage0045_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$イズモ$$
（And so we planned to capture a woman able
　to endure Altair's environment, a $$レア・イグラー$$,
　and make her the Eve of our world's future.）

stage0045_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$イズモ$$
（And one of the candidates chosen was you, $$アリシア$$...）

stage0045_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$イズモ$$
（But the dimensional transfer left you in a state
　of suspended death, and you never woke.）

stage0045_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$イズモ$$
（You even left your child behind on Vega
　just to come here to Altair...）

stage0045_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$イズモ$$
（...But I am not permitted to stop...）

stage0045_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$イズモ$$
（I'm counting on you, $$ジン$$...
　The $$レア・イグラー$$ riding the Mechanical Angel...
　bring her back, no matter what.）

stage0045_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$イズモ$$
（That is the true Eve who will save Altair's tomorrow.）

stage0045_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Heh heh... $$イズモ$$'s with $$アリシア$$ again, is he...
　A wingless butterfly's scales are but an illusion...）

stage0045_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（The butterfly hints at rebirth...
　A forbidden love, too, will be reborn...）

stage0045_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$...!
　Why do you keep me bound like this?!」

stage0045_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Fufu... doesn't this remind you of your childhood?
　The helpless boy you were, when we were together...」

stage0045_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I'm not...! I'm not that kid anymore!!
　GRAAAAAAAAAAH!!」

stage0045_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes, that's it, $$カグラ$$...
　More, much more... let loose the senseless past
　that keeps raging on inside you...!」

stage0045_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Hold nothing back, not a single drop!
　Yes... the $$アポロン$$ and $$シルフィ$$ memories in you!」

stage0045_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$シルフィ$$ is right there, close to your heart.
　Her breath is sweet, and her honeyed voice
　brings heavenly bliss.」

stage0045_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「There now... you thirst for love, don't you?
　You want that forbidden union too, don't you?
　$$カグラ$$...! Want it more, and more...! More!」

stage0045_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's it...!
　Roar for love, you starving beast!!」

stage0045_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now, to quench your thirst,
　set out for a love that's yours alone...」

stage0045_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Kill me...!
　I want to hold you in these hands and break you...!
　My... $$シルフィ$$eeee!!」

stage0045_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The dark embodiment of the cosmos, a hollow wanderer
　seeking new life... Yes... Vega is the edge of myth...」

stage0045_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Sooner or later, they will appear...!
　And that will be when my wish is fulfilled!」

stage0045_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Still a little hung up on $$グーラ$$, it seems...
　$$ワッ太$$ and $$タケル$$ are looking after him though」

stage0045_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$朔哉$$
「That's rare, $$カイエン$$.
　You worrying about someone else」

stage0045_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I do think highly of $$正太郎$$, you know.
　Those straightforward eyes of his... full of
　a will too strong for a kid his age」

stage0045_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Some pathetic guy out there ought to take notes.」

stage0045_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Don't worry about it.
　Some of us know you're doing just fine, $$アマタ$$」

stage0045_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$アルト$$
「Fighting aside, in $$アマタ$$'s case
　he's got some effort to put in elsewhere」

stage0045_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Don't tell me you want $$アマタ$$ two-timing too?」

stage0045_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll say it again,
　I never two-timed anyone, damn it!」

stage0045_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$葵$$
「Honestly, I'm getting tired of this topic.
　Time you settled it already」

stage0045_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$くらら$$
「Two-timing aside for $$アルト$$ and $$アマタ$$,
　I'd like to cheer up $$正太郎$$ somehow」

stage0045_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$クラン$$
「Agreed.
　He's not one to lean on others normally,
　so I want to do something for him now」

stage0045_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's $$正太郎$$ for you.
　A huge hit with the older ladies」

stage0045_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Tch... maybe I'll switch to shorts too」

stage0045_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$葵$$
「If you think it'd suit you,
　you need Ruu-Ruu's counseling」

stage0045_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「At least shave your shins first, please」

stage0045_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Such a cruel thing to say...」

stage0045_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アルト$$
「...About $$正太郎$$,
　what if we invited him out to unwind?」

stage0045_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「No thanks if it's 'Celestial Being'.
　$$ワッ太$$ would love it though」

stage0045_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Not that.
　I'm thinking of ordering 'Do You Remember
　Love' from the Frontier fleet」

stage0045_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$アンディ$$
「What kind of movie is that, anyway?」

stage0045_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$クラン$$
「It's about the warrior race Zentradi,
　who knew no culture, hearing $$リン・ミンメイ$$'s
　songs and finding a path to coexist with Earth」

stage0045_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I see...
　So the concept's reconciling with hostile aliens」

stage0045_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ルカ$$
「But wouldn't that be...
　something $$正太郎$$'s already seen?」

stage0045_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「True.
　It came out when the Frontier fleet
　transferred here, and it was a huge hit」

stage0045_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$アルト$$
「Thought it was a good idea, but no good...」

stage0045_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「...A similar movie... I know one」

stage0045_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Yeah.
　Two enemy races fall in love while fighting」

stage0045_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「That's right... it's '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$'」

stage0045_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's it, $$ミコノ$$!
　That should definitely cheer up $$正太郎$$!」

stage0045_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Say that, but you got the film?
　No movie theater's transferred to this world」

stage0045_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$不動$$
「Been a while, hasn't it, all of you.」

stage0045_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Supreme Commander $$不動$$...!
　Why are you on the Quarter!?」

stage0045_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$不動$$
「I came to greet you.
　...How's that for an answer?」

stage0045_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Even if you ask me that...」

stage0045_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Supreme Commander, you said 'no need to worry'...」

stage0045_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$不動$$
「The film for '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$'...
　I'll arrange it myself」

stage0045_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「The supreme commander really can do anything, huh」

stage0045_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アンディ$$
「But hey, thanks a ton!
　Now that's settled, let's throw a screening!」

stage0045_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$葵$$
「A movie from the world of Aquaria, huh...
　Sounds fun」

stage0045_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「If we're doing it, why not $$聖天使学園$$?
　Loads of people could watch there together」

stage0045_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Sounds like it'll be quite the event.
　In that case...」

stage0045_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「I know, $$エイーダ$$.
　Let's leave the arrangements to that person」

stage0045_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Of course, let's have them meet your expectations」

stage0045_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Leave this to us, $$アルト$$.
　We'll make this event a success, no matter what」

stage0045_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I heard it was a movie screening at Holy
　Angel Academy, but it's this huge!?」

stage0045_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ウラジミール$$
「I hope you enjoyed it, $$早乙女アルト$$?」

stage0045_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're the one who was with $$エイーダ$$ before...!」

stage0045_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's right.
　$$ウラジミール$$ runs an event company now,
　and we left this one in his hands.」

stage0045_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「By the way, $$ウラジミール$$
　also has a partnership with Vector Promotion.」

stage0045_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シェリル$$
「That's right.
　$$ランカ$$ and I... $$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$
　is doing a live show at this event too.」

stage0045_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Keep your voice down, $$ワッ太$$.
　This is my private time right now.」

stage0045_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$アルト$$
「You... sure about this?
　Skipping rehearsal to be here...」

stage0045_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Is that any way to talk to a girl
　who came all this way to see you?」

stage0045_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ウラジミール$$
「$$シェリル$$... there's still time before the stage.」

stage0045_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Well then, I'll take you up on that.
　...Shall we go, $$アルト$$?」

stage0045_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Anywhere's fine.
　As long as $$アルト$$'s escorting me.」

stage0045_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$アルト$$, if we don't hurry, people nearby
　will notice $$シェリル$$ and it'll cause a scene.」

stage0045_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Come on... show $$正太郎$$
　what real grown-up composure looks like.」

stage0045_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$アルト$$
「Well, I'm heading out for a bit.
　$$正太郎$$, have fun while I'm gone.」

stage0045_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「That was unusually forward of $$アルト$$.」

stage0045_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Is that alright, $$エイーダ$$?
　I thought you were rooting for $$ランカ$$.」

stage0045_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「This time, I'm not really in a position
　to think about that...」

stage0045_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「For now, all I can do is trust $$アルト$$.」

stage0045_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ジン$$
「...I know, I know.
　My report was just a little late, that's all...」

stage0045_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ジン$$
「I'll bring the Mechanical Angel's $$レア・イグラー$$ back,
　just as expected, their guard's loosening up,
　so my chance will come soon.」

stage0045_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ジン$$
「Phew...
　$$イズモ$$ seems awfully anxious too, huh...」

stage0045_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ジン$$
（Guess I'm about at my limit for stalling this...）

stage0045_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「It seemed like someone was here just now...」

stage0045_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ジン$$
（That call with Altair... it wasn't overheard, right...）

stage0045_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「'$$アクエリアの舞う空$$'... the screening will start soon.」

stage0045_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ジン$$
「Did you... come to get me?」

stage0045_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「...Want to watch it together?
　I've... never seen that movie before...」

stage0045_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Then I'll... go ahead and save us seats...」

stage0045_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Huh... for $$アルト$$,
　you sure know a stylish spot.」

stage0045_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$シェリル$$
「What's wrong, going all quiet...
　Planning some big confession?」

stage0045_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$...
　Stop putting on a brave face for me.」

stage0045_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$アルト$$
「You spared this time before the stage
　because you wanted to tell me something, right?」

stage0045_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$シェリル$$
「...You can see right through me...
　That leaves me with mixed feelings...」

stage0045_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$シェリル$$
「I just lost a bit of confidence...」

stage0045_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$アルト$$
「What are you talking about?
　Even I know how popular
　$$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$ is.」

stage0045_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$シェリル$$
「But... it didn't reach the Vajra...」

stage0045_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$アルト$$
「You mean at $$アクエリア市$$'s founding ceremony?」

stage0045_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$'s song was the same way, huh.
　How's she holding up?」

stage0045_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Yeah, it really seems to have shaken her.
　She goes off alone and mopes sometimes.」

stage0045_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$シェリル$$
「No good...
　It's supposed to be my job to lift her spirits
　at times like this...」

stage0045_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're you.
　Caring about $$ランカ$$, about others, is great, but
　when you're sad, look after yourself too.」

stage0045_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll help you with that too.」

stage0045_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$シェリル$$
「For someone else... huh...
　Now that I think about it, that's all
　I've ever thought about while singing...」

stage0045_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$シェリル$$
「I sing for the people who listen to me...
　So it must be why it hit me so hard
　when the Vajra wouldn't listen...」

stage0045_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're just a little worn out, you and $$ランカ$$ both.
　Ever since the $$新世時空震動$$, you've had
　no rest, running events and ceremonies everywhere.」

stage0045_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$アルト$$
「There's still time before the stage.
　Take a bit to relax here.」

stage0045_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Though this is about all I can do.」

stage0045_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$シェリル$$
「It's plenty, $$アルト$$.
　Next, I should do the same for $$ランカ$$...」

stage0045_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アルト$$
「Stop right there, $$シェリル$$.
　Just think about yourself for now.」

stage0045_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$シェリル$$
（I'll do just that, $$アルト$$...
　For now, forgetting about $$ランカ$$ and the Vajra,
　and about myself...）

stage0045_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$シェリル$$
（And I'll think of only you.）

stage0045_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「This makes me happy, $$アマタ$$.
　Everyone here... they all came to see
　'$$アクエリアの舞う空$$'.」

stage0045_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$...
　There's something I've always wanted
　to apologize to you for.」

stage0045_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That time... because I got you into Aquarion,
　you ended up caught up in danger...」

stage0045_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$アマタ$$
「More than that, if I'd never
　spoken to you, maybe you wouldn't have had
　to go through anything so scary...」

stage0045_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's not your fault, $$アマタ$$.
　I chose that fate for myself.」

stage0045_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アリシア$$ said it too, in the movie.
　'Everyone has wings to leap beyond fate.'」

stage0045_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$アマタ$$
「...I wonder if mom leapt beyond
　her fate that way too...」

stage0045_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I... was abandoned by my mom as a kid...」

stage0045_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$アマタ$$
「And that mom...
　is the one who played $$シルフィ$$ in
　'$$アクエリアの舞う空$$'... $$アリシア$$.」

stage0045_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アリシア$$ is... $$アマタ$$'s mother...」

stage0045_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Mom leapt over her fate so easily,
　and left me behind to go somewhere else...
　All I could do was watch her go...」

stage0045_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「To my mom, I was just an unwanted child...」

stage0045_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「...I'm the same way.
　$$カイエン$$ was always the capable one,
　and I was always the hopeless one...」

stage0045_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「The Suzushiro family's had strong Element ability
　for generations, but I have none, left behind...
　Even when $$カイエン$$ joined Neo-DEAVA...」

stage0045_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「But even if I'm hopeless,
　that doesn't mean I'm unwanted!」

stage0045_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「No one is truly unwanted...
　Someone, somewhere, surely needs them...
　waiting for them...」

stage0045_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「...That's what $$アマタ$$
　made me realize, so I...」

stage0045_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Are you okay just watching $$アマタ$$ like that?」

stage0045_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I misjudged you, $$ゼシカ$$...
　I thought you were the same type as me,
　someone who fights for what they want.」

stage0045_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「...I'm not that strong.
　But that's fine.」

stage0045_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I've got my own way of doing things.」

stage0045_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$アスカ$$
「That's not just sour grapes, is it?」

stage0045_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No way...!
　This isn't over just because of today.」

stage0045_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$シンジ$$
「What? I just thought we'd watch a movie together」

stage0045_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Oh, it's you!
　Do you even know what that movie's about?」

stage0045_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$シンジ$$
「No, I don't.
　Because if I heard the story first,
　I wouldn't enjoy it as much...」

stage0045_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Then just watch it with $$ジン$$!」

stage0045_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$ジン$$'s with $$ユノハ$$, so
　I didn't want to intrude...」

stage0045_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Why can you be considerate like that...!
　And yet you, of all people!」

stage0045_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「W-what are you even mad about...?」

stage0045_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「See you, $$アスカ$$.
　I'll get out of your way now」

stage0045_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Let's go, Shikinami.
　The movie's about to start」

stage0045_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$アスカ$$
「F-fine, I suppose...!
　You'd better buy me popcorn, at least!」

stage0045_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Okay, then.
　Ayanami, you'll have some too, right?」

stage0045_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$アスカ$$
「So you play favorites too, huh?」

stage0045_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Yeah...
　We're both EVA pilots, but
　we've hardly talked, so I thought it'd be a good chance...」

stage0045_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Oh, $$トウジ$$ and Class Rep are coming soon, too」

stage0045_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$アポロン$$
「$$シルフィ$$...
　I've crossed 12,000 years to see you again」

stage0045_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$アポロン$$
「Now, let's fight the $$堕天翅$$ with our love's power」

stage0045_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$シルフィ$$
「Yes...
　For this beautiful world...」

stage0045_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$バナージ$$
（So this is '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$'...）

stage0045_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$オードリー$$
（If only everyone could connect like this...）

stage0045_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ロゼ$$
（Surely people can, beyond star and race,
　still come to love one another...）

stage0045_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$ゼクス$$
（That man, $$アポロン$$...
　did he give up everything for love...）

stage0045_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ミシェル$$
（Hey... $$クラン$$, wipe your nose）

stage0045_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$クラン$$
（These are tears!
　Don't ruin a perfectly good moment!）

stage0045_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$甲児$$
（Whoa, that love scene's hotter than I thought...）

stage0045_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$甲児$$
（A-aren't you sitting too close, $$さやか$$?）

stage0045_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$カレン$$
（Thinking about $$フィアナ$$, aren't you, $$キリコ$$...）

stage0045_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Not bad, for $$宗介$$.
　Inviting me to a movie like this...）

stage0045_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$宗介$$
（I'm sorry...
　I thought there'd be more action scenes...）

stage0045_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ジン$$
（I wonder why...
　Even seeing $$シルフィ$$, who I used to adore,
　I don't feel as excited as before...）

stage0045_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Kind of.
　I don't feel too bad right now.」

stage0045_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Strange, isn't it.
　He's back in that role again.」

stage0045_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$不動$$
「Karma...
　Is that what they call fate?」

stage0045_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$カヲル$$
「You don't intend to obey something like that, do you?」

stage0045_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Then you understand why I came, don't you?」

stage0045_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$カヲル$$
「A dull sense of duty doesn't suit you, does it?
　You broke that very taboo 24,000 years ago.」

stage0045_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$カヲル$$
「So you should just be honest with yourself.
　After all... we're no different from them.」

stage0045_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$カヲル$$
「I don't want to see that look on his face again.
　Even if I'm not the one standing beside him.」

stage0045_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$不動$$
「Within the cycle of rebirth, fate's partner changes...
　After 12,000 years, a new door opens.」

stage0045_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Even if where it leads is the edge of myth.」

stage0045_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$不動$$
「The one who spins that cruel fate...
　Show yourself!」

stage0045_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
???
「Oh... as expected.
　So you'd already noticed...」

stage0045_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... I never meant to come somewhere like this,
　but it seems a lovely sound drew me in」

stage0045_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$クレア$$
「Drawn in by $$熱気バサラ$$'s singing...?」

stage0045_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's no mere vibration in the air...
　A life force that transcends dimensions...」

stage0045_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Watch out, $$スオミ$$!
　This guy's our enemy!」

stage0045_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's been a while, $$ドナール・ダンテス$$.
　Not since you and Nanao made Aquarion go berserk」

stage0045_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ドナール$$
「I've never once forgotten you...!
　The enemy from another dimension
　who stole Nanao from me!」

stage0045_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Your love was simply too beautiful.
　It made me want to be a little mean」

stage0045_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But I have no business with you today」

stage0045_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's been quite a while.
　Ten thousand and two thousand years...
　or maybe twenty thousand and four thousand...」

stage0045_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$不動$$
「Heh... finally decided to show yourself?」

stage0045_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What an unsightly form to be in, though...
　Where did you leave your true form behind?」

stage0045_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$不動$$
「The form the eye sees is but a curse...
　An obsession with the past, nothing more...
　Is it not you who can't discard the old form?」

stage0045_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...Very well, let's not waste time.
　Tell me where the 'Book of Genesis' and True Sun are」

stage0045_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Come now, give me your answer,
　my lover of twenty thousand and four thousand years」

stage0045_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then watch as those you love
　fall into despair」

stage0045_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$不動$$
「$$ゲパルト$$, $$ジン・ムソウ$$!
　$$スパーダ$$, $$ユノハ・スルール$$!」

stage0045_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Who is this $$ジン・ムソウ$$!?」

stage0045_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$ジン$$
「My name is $$ジン・ムソウ$$.
　I'm from the world of Altair」

stage0045_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ジン$$
「The world of what you all call Abductors」

stage0045_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ドナール$$
「You...!
　I knew it, you were their spy after all!」

stage0045_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ジン$$
「The only way to break this deadlock
　is to use my power」

stage0045_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ドナール$$
「What are you saying, now of all times!?」

stage0045_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$ジン$$
「If you can't trust me, then don't!
　But the power to sever I gained here
　is the only way to close the dimensional gate!」

stage0045_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　$$ゲパルト$$, $$ジン・ムソウ$$!
　$$スパーダ$$, $$ユノハ・スルール$$!」

stage0045_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Can I ask you something instead?
　$$ジン$$, did you ask to tour NERV
　just to spy on us?」

stage0045_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Besides, $$ジン$$, your Element ability awoke,
　and you tried to protect $$ユノハ$$ above all.」

stage0045_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You don't need to say it, $$ジン$$.
　I was the same way once.」

stage0045_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Now I can laugh together with everyone.
　Because I'm part of $c」

stage0045_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Even if we're born on different planets,
　our hearts can still connect, right...」

stage0045_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Watching $$正太郎$$ and the others,
　and $$タケル$$, don't you think so?」

stage0045_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$ユノハ$$... meeting you was a miracle,
　it nearly takes my breath away... Holding your hand,
　I feel a little stronger... so...」

stage0045_03:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Even I will hold back today.
　My toast to the ace pilot will have to wait...」

stage0045_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The D-Trader is open for business, though,
　so feel free to stop by if you need anything...」
